content:
Canva today launched Canva Code 2.0, an AI-powered vibe coding platform that lets users create and visually edit websites, apps, and interactive experiences. Details below.

"Create websites, apps, and interactive experiences with vibe coding, then edit them like a Canva design."

A few months ago, Canva announced Canva AI 2.0, a unified conversational interface for design, automation, and content creation, built on the company's Proteus, Lucid Origin, and I2V generative image and video models.

Today, the company is further expanding its AI-powered coding tools with the launch of Canva Code 2.0, which—through "new features that combine creative control with the latest AI coding models"—promises to make designing interactive experiences "simple, engaging, easy to build, and customizable to your brand."

Canva Code 2.0 lets users start from a prompt, choose from over 50 new templates, or import HTML to continue working on pages built in other AI platforms or assistants. The platform also supports real-time collaboration among team members.

It also integrates seamlessly with Canva's other tools, giving users greater creative control and making it easier to keep their work consistent with their brand style.

Canva says:

When the work is ready to publish, Canva Code 2.0 lets users connect a custom domain or publish to a free Canva domain. The company notes that the output is fully interactive, automatically adapts to different screen sizes, and can be previewed on mobile before going live.
